sharedPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE vertical production illustration for a 5:7 historical strategy battle card, art only. Image1 is the existing character identity reference; image2 is the approved game UI style reference (look at its Zhang Fei card). Create a dedicated WAR CARD illustration with a rich warm painted battlefield background and heroic CLOSE-UP composition matching that card’s painterly style. Preserve image1’s recognizable face, age, hair/beard, costume identity and role. Crop at waist/chest with large head and shoulders filling the card, face around upper third, keep headgear fully visible. Human character is the dominant focus, environment secondary. Warm daylight, parchment gold, earth colors, convincing historical fabrics/metal, illustrated brushwork, coherent atmosphere. This is game art, not an archaeological reconstruction. Full-bleed environment all the way to edges. No UI, no frame, no lettering/numbers, no title, no watermark, no logos, no black/flat studio backdrop, no full-body standing catalog portrait, no tiny figure, no extra foreground characters, no magical effects. Do not copy UI elements into the illustration.
